origin.description: Run code with temporary graphics parameters.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Mapping of parameter names to values.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while those parameters are set.

origin.details: During the call col is red. Afterwards it is black again, which is the stored default.
origin.example:
old <- par("col")
inside <- with_par(list(col = "red", pch = 19), par("col"))
c(inside, par("col"), old)

translation.description: Run code with temporary graphics parameters.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Mapping of parameter names to values.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while those parameters are set.

translation.details: During the call col is red. Afterwards it is black again, which is the stored default. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

old = par("col")
inside = with_par({"col": "red", "pch": 19}, lambda: par("col"))
return [inside, par("col"), old]
